notes: Five rules for builders. (1) Bank vs holding company: the desk's Call Report/UBPR data describe each insured bank; the SEC registrant is usually the holding company; never mix levels in one ratio, and PCA categories apply only to the bank (the holding-company 'well-capitalized' test is 12 CFR 225.2(r), with different lines). (2) Two regulator definitions often coexist and differ: UBPR NIM is tax-equivalent, FDIC QBP NIM is not; UBPR efficiency ratio keeps intangible amortization, FDIC's removes it; UBPR CRE concentration divides by Tier 1 capital + ACL while the 2006 guidance divides by total risk-based capital. Label the definition on every line. (3) Regulatory lines move and must be pinned to an eCFR point-in-time date: the CBLR line fell from >9% to >8% on 2026-07-01 (91 FR 22973), and the 6% SLR well-capitalized criterion for GSIB bank subsidiaries left 12 CFR 324.403 on 2026-04-01 (90 FR 55248).
